title: The Impostor Examiner and Hisokas Test — Part 6

series.summary: Emerging into the misty Numere Wetlands, the applicants are confronted by a mysterious man claiming examiner Satotz is a deceptive monster. Hisoka tests them with lethal playing cards, killing the impostor and allowing the true trial to proceed.

segments.voiceover_text: The survivors emerge into the foggy Numere Wetlands. Satotz warns that deceptive monsters inhabit the swamp, mimicking humans to lead victims to their doom.
Suddenly, a battered man drags out a dead ape with Satotz's exact face. The stranger claims Satotz is an impostor, throwing the crowd into total paranoia.
Without warning, Hisoka flings razor-sharp playing cards at both figures. Satotz catches the blades effortlessly between his fingers, while the accuser drops dead instantly.
Hisoka smiles, declaring that a real Hunter examiner would never fail to defend himself. Satotz warns against future attacks, leading the survivors deeper into the perilous mist.
